{{Quote|You have arrived. I am Axis, the knowledge-seeking. You see I am completely untouchable. We will now come to an agreement that benefits us both.|Axis|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Axis''' was an [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a supporter to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He infiltrated the [[Hutt Data Center]] of [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to gain access to its information. He attempted to formally offer his services to the Empire, but was killed by Imperial-affiliated spacers due to being too much of a security risk for the Empire to tolerate.

==Behind the scenes==
Axis is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Kiff VandenHeuvel]].
